title: Eurydice of Macedon
summary: Raleigh names Eurydice of Macedon in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Eurydice the Illyrian, wife of Amyntas the second, mother of Alexander the second, Perdiccas the third, and Philip the second. The one-word title would not say which, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book IV, Part I, Chapter I, §. I, sig. 461a
